verdicts.rationale: The un-modeled divergence is the Hold-E variable offset (all frames, spawnsAt, and cooldownStartDelay shift by the player-chosen hold duration). This is not a fixed game value the timeline misstates but a player-controlled positioning nicety — holding E only adjusts throw distance/direction and is not part of any DPS rotation. The default tap-E timing (hold=0) is modeled correctly. It also isn't cleanly implementable: a fixed variant offset would misstate a variable one, and cooldownStartDelay on Hold/tap variants is on the CANNOT-model list. Not decision-relevant; fails the purpose test.

groundedIn.claim: The Hold-E offset is variable and player-controlled, not a fixed value.
groundedIn.quote: Hold E variant: all frames += hold parameter (variable), Baron Bunny spawnsAt = 45+hold, cooldownStartDelay = 5+hold. Variable offset not modeled in variants[].

groundedIn.claim: Hold only adjusts throw direction/distance — a positioning mechanic, not a rotation timing.
groundedIn.quote:
Adjusts the throwing direction of Baron Bunny.
The longer the button is held, the further the throw.

verdicts.rationale: The only un-modeled half is the 30% AoE widening, which is AoE size — explicitly constitution-excluded from caveats. The other half of the passive (the +10% CRIT Rate on Fiery Rain) is already authored as a buff effect during the burst window, so nothing decision-relevant diverges. No caveat warranted.

groundedIn.claim: Only the AoE-radius half is unmodeled, which has no schema surface.
groundedIn.quote: AoE widening (30% on Fiery Rain AoE) not modeled — no schema field for AoE radius modifiers.

groundedIn.claim: The CRIT Rate half is modeled; only the AoE-widening half is out of scope.
groundedIn.quote: Increases the CRIT Rate of Fiery Rain by 10% and widens its AoE by 30%.
